stem:
The dot plot shows the number of points scored by each player on a basketball team during a game.

Which statement is NOT supported by the information shown in the dot plot?

options.label: A
options.text: Exactly 20% of the players scored 6 points during the game.

options.label: B
options.text: Exactly 40% of the players scored 3 points during the game.

options.label: C
options.text: Less than \(\frac{1}{3}\) of the players scored 4 points during the game.

options.label: D
options.text: More than \(\frac{1}{10}\) of the players scored 8 points during the game.

visual_elements: Dot plot titled 'Basketball Game' showing points scored 0 to 8 along a horizontal axis with dots above each number representing players. The dot counts are: 2 dots above 0, 1 dot above 2, 6 dots above 3, 3 dots above 4, 0 dots above 5, 3 dots above 6, 0 dots above 7, and 1 dot above 8. Note states: Each dot represents 1 player.
